text.en:
Interacting with Elemental Pickups progresses a counter. Reaching 100% Counter Progress grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

Counter Progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• <solar/>Firesprites: 50%|50%|100%
• <void/>Void Breaches: 50%|50%|100%
• <strand/>Strand Tangles: 50%|50%|100%
• <arc/>Ionic Traces: 34%|50%|50%
• <stasis/>Stasis Shards: 25%|34%|50%

Interacting with Elemental Pickups progresses a counter. Reaching 100% Counter Progress grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

Counter Progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:

• <arc/>Ionic Traces: 34%|50%|50%
• <stasis/>Stasis Shards: 25%|34%|50%

Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying <strand/>Tangles grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Activation Progress.

• <arc/>Ionic Traces: 34%|50%|50%
• <stasis/>Stasis Shards: 25%|34%|50%
